title_zh: 约定集中审核设计稿的剩余问题

scenario.label_zh: 约定集中审核设计稿的剩余问题
scenario.goal_zh: 说明反复修改造成的困扰，并约定收集意见后集中审核一次

context_zh: 设计师与项目负责人讨论设计稿在多个意见版本之间反复流转的问题。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: I'm frustrated. This layout keeps going back and forth between three reviewers.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: We are only halfway through the project, but that is no reason to keep reopening settled choices.

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: Could you gather their remaining comments in one place before I make another version?

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: Yes. I'll ask for one combined list by Thursday, and we can review it together on Friday.

sentences.speaker: Seth
sentences.text: Thanks. I will wait for that list instead of reacting to each separate message.

targets.sense_zh: 向前；用于 back and forth 表示来回
